original_source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.

Jung6 Android ge3 dong2 on3 syun2 zaak6 hei3 gaa1 zeoi3 do1 20 zoeng1 tou4 pin2. Haa6 min6 tok3 pun4 wui5 hin2 si6 suk1 tou4, dong2 on3 ming4 cing1, coi4 zin2 tung4 “Jat1 joeng6 fut3 dou6” waak6 ze2 “Jat1 joeng6 gou1 dou6” tiu4 zing2 hau6 ge3 tou4 pin2 cek3 cyun3; jyu4 gwo2 dong2 on3 tai4 gung1 ze2 jau5 tai4 gung1 sau1 goi2 si4 gaan1, tok3 pun4 jik6 wui5 hin2 si6. Ho2 ji5 on3 dong2 on3 ming4 cing1 waak6 ze2 sau1 goi2 si4 gaan1 paai4 zeoi6; paai4 zeoi6 m4 wui5 cung4 san1 paai4 lit6 ji5 baai2 wai6 ge3 tou4 pin2.

Gam6 jat1 haa5 suk1 tou4 lai4 gaan2 tou4 pin2. “Coi4 zin2 tou4 pin2” wui5 coi4 zin2 go2 zoeng1 tou4 pin2; “Pai1 ci3 coi4 zin2” wui5 on3 zoeng6 sou3 waak6 ze2 baak3 fan1 bei2 ge3 bin1 keoi5 coi4 zin2 gaan2 zo2 ge3 tou4 pin2. To1 coi4 zin2 hung3 zai3 dim2 waak6 ze2 syu1 jap6 sou3 zik6. “Cung4 cit3 coi4 zin2” wui5 waan4 jyun4 jyun4 bun2 ge3 bin1 jyun4. Coi4 zin2 m4 wui5 po3 waai6 jyun4 tou4, ji4 ce2 ho2 ji5 fuk6 jyun4.

Gam6 zyu6 suk1 tou4, waak6 ze2 to1 gung1 zok3 keoi1 jap6 min6 ji5 baai2 wai6 ge3 tou4 pin2, zoi3 fong3 dou3 jau5 dak6 bit6 biu1 si6 ge3 bin1 jyun4. Bun3 tau3 ming4 jyu6 laam5 wui5 hin2 si6 zeon2 kok3 ge3 tip3 cai4 git3 gwo2. Zip3 dou3 jau6 bin1 si4 wui5 deoi3 cai4 ding2 bou6; zip3 dou3 haa6 min6 si4 wui5 deoi3 cai4 zo2 bin1. Nei5 jik6 ho2 ji5 sin1 gam6 jat1 haa5 suk1 tou4, zoi3 gam6 “+” muk6 biu1. Jung6 tip3 cai4 fong1 sik1 baai2 wai6 si4, dai6 jat1 zoeng1 tou4 pin2 wui5 jau4 jyun4 dim2 hoi1 ci2. Coi4 zin2 jat1 zoeng1 tou4 pin2 si4, zip3 hai2 keoi5 bin1 jyun4 ge3 tou4 pin2 ho2 nang4 wui5 juk1. Jung6 tip3 cai4 fong1 sik1 baai2 wai6 si4, m4 jung4 heoi2 tou4 pin2 cung4 dip6.

Gaan2 jat1 zoeng1 tou4 pin2, zoi3 jung6 “Zeon2 kok3 wai6 zi3” cit3 ding6 keoi5 zo2 soeng6 gok3 ge3 X/Y zo6 biu1, ji5 zing2 sou3 zoeng6 sou3 gai3, jau4 0 hoi1 ci2. Kei4 taa1 tou4 pin2 wui5 bou2 ci4 jyun4 wai6, ji4 ce2 ni1 dou6 jung4 heoi2 cung4 dip6.

“Jat1 joeng6 fut3 dou6” tung4 “Jat1 joeng6 gou1 dou6” wui5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 syu1 jap6 tou4 pin2 tiu4 dou3 jat1 joeng6 ge3 fut3 dou6 waak6 gou1 dou6, tung4 si4 bou2 lau4 mui5 zoeng1 tou4 pin2 bun2 san1 ge3 fut3 dou6 tung4 gou1 dou6 ge3 bei2 lai6. Ho2 ji5 gaan2 zoeng6 sou3, baak3 fan1 bei2, “Zeoi3 siu2” waak6 ze2 “Zeoi3 daai6”. “Waan4 jyun4 jyun4 bun2 daai6 siu2” wui5 ceoi2 siu1 cek3 cyun3 tung2 jat1, daan6 bou2 lau4 coi4 zin2.

“Ceoi2 siu1 baai2 wai6” zi2 wui5 zoeng1 gaan2 zo2 ge3 tou4 pin2 fong3 faan1 tok3 pun4. Kei4 taa1 tou4 pin2 wui5 wai4 ci4 ji5 baai2 wai6 zong6 taai3; lin4 zip3 zyu6 ge3 tou4 pin2 ho2 nang4 wui5 juk1 lai4 tin4 bou2 hung1 wai6. “Ji4 ceoi4” zi2 wui5 saan1 ceoi4 go2 zoeng1 syu1 jap6 tou4 pin2. “Fuk6 jyun4” / “Cung4 zou6” ho2 ji5 waan4 jyun4 ni1 di1 goi2 dung6. To1 ji5 baai2 wai6 ge3 tou4 pin2 ho2 ji5 cung4 san1 paai4 lit6; hai2 hung1 baak6 wai6 zi3 to1 dung6 ho2 ji5 ping4 ji4 si6 tou4. Jung6 loeng5 zek3 sau2 zi2 hap6 maai4 waak6 ze2 fan1 hoi1 lai4 suk1 fong3. “Hin2 si6 cyun4 bou6” wui5 tiu4 zing2 suk1 fong3 bei2 lai6 lai4 hin2 si6 zing2 go3 ping3 hap6 git3 gwo2; m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 syu1 ceot1 cek3 cyun3.

“Cyu5 cyun4 PNG” wui5 zik6 zip3 cyu5 cyun4 ping3 hap6 hau6 ge3 tou4 pin2. “Hai2 Paint pin1 cap1” wui5 zoeng1 tou4 pin2 cyun4 sung3 dou3 zyu2 pin1 cap1 hei3, zok3 wai4 ho2 fuk6 jyun4 ge3 tou4 pin2 ceoi2 doi6 cou1 zok3. Jyu4 gwo2 syu1 ceot1 ciu1 ceot1 gei3 jik1 tai2 soeng6 haan6, ji4 cing4 sik1 jau5 tai4 gung1 cek3 cyun3 syun2 zaak6 waa2 min6, cing2 gaan2 gaau3 siu2 ge3 syu1 ceot1 fu3 bun2. Jyu4 gwo2 lin4 gik6 siu2 ge3 syu1 ceot1 dou1 ciu1 ceot1 gei3 jik1 tai2 soeng6 haan6, cing4 sik1 wui5 hin2 si6 gei3 jik1 tai2 ging2 gou3, m4 wui5 hin2 si6 cek3 cyun3 syun2 zaak6 waa2 min6. Jyun4 bun2 ge3 loi4 jyun4 dong2 on3 m4 wui5 bei6 sau1 goi2. Ji4 gaa1 ge3 ping3 hap6 zong6 taai3 wui5 cyu5 cyun4 hai2 zong1 zi3 noi6, nei5 faan1 lai4 si4 wui5 zoi3 daa2 hoi1.

Ni1 go3 mou4 sik1 jung6 zyu2 pin1 cap1 hei3 “Dong2 on3 > Gwaan1 jyu1, sau6 kyun4 tung4 ming4 ze6” min6 baan2 soeng6 hin2 si6 ge3 tung4 jat1 tou3 Catrobat/AGPL tung4 sou3 coi4 ming4 ze6 zi1 liu2.
